name: Karlsruhe

queries.query: Karlsruhe Germany official cadastral map parcels geoportal API
queries.result: Found the official City of Karlsruhe Geoportal, its municipal open-data/geoservices page, and the municipal Liegenschaftskataster service page. The Geoportal explicitly advertises a parcel-background map, but no public parcel feature API was confirmed in this attempt.

queries.query: Karlsruhe amtliche Flurkarte Geoportal Flurstücke WFS
queries.result: Found the official municipal pages naming the Regiokarte mit Flurstücken, the three cadastral Gemarkungen, the Liegenschaftsamt, and the paid Liegenschaftskataster extract service. The open-data page says municipal WMS services are available on request; no anonymous parcel WFS endpoint was published there.

officialSources.evidence: Official page identifies Regiokarte mit Flurstücken as a municipal map containing parcels and states Karlsruhe has three cadastral Gemarkungen used for parcel numbering.
Official page documents municipal geoservices and says the Regiokarte and aerial-photo WMS services are available on request.
Official service page identifies the municipal Liegenschaftskataster extract service and its cadastral-map output.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Verified TLS GET returned the current ArcGIS Experience Builder iframe HTML and its ArcGIS JS API configuration; web viewer fetch timed out before a usable map/API response. Exact WUP point was not shifted and no absence was inferred.
Anonymous ArcGIS REST item lookup returned HTTP application error 400, Item does not exist or is inaccessible; no layer schema or service URL was obtained.
Official open-data documentation was retrieved. It advertises municipal WMS services, but says they are available on request and provides no public anonymous parcel feature endpoint.

nextStep: Serial reviewer should obtain or verify a current anonymous municipal parcel endpoint or an authorized public WMS/WFS service, without credentials or unsafe fields, and keep runtime readiness held until independently qualified.
